lines.en: Leaner than my kin, and meaner.
I move fast across the ice.
My shell carries a blue glow.
I shovel the snow aside.
I crawl along the ice ridge.
Frost rims my segments.
This ice field belongs to us.
I follow the other three.
My trail is cold.
My jaws work open and shut.
Cold rises off my back.
I crawl toward where the living things are.
The ice is slick. I grip it fine.
When I stop, snow settles on me.
I turn and go on.
It is too warm here. Unpleasant.
I lie still, blue light pulsing.
I grow colder by the moment.
I am saving that cold breath.
Snow lands on my segments.
I wait to frost over.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地的风，吹得我发亮。
lines.en: Ice-spike wind makes my shell shine.
I listen to the water under the ice.
The ice is thick here.
I sway my head slowly.
I count how many kin are left.
The ice reflects the light.
I count the falling snowflakes.
You are very warm.
I dislike warm things.
Let me see how long you last.
The ice under you is thin.
I am four paces off.
The ice shell cracks, then my blast.
This ground is mine to tread.
You smell like blood.
My eyes glow beneath my shell.
Do not back off. It is colder back there.
When I burst, ice shards fly.
I rolled over, claws up.
Half my cold bled out.
My legs tremble.
Not a grave wound.
The frost is knocked off my shell.
I flatten and pass for ice.
If I can still move, I can still burst.
Some red on the snow.
Again — my shell is still hard.
Iron? Give it.
Toss that iron over.
Your hand is too warm. Hold it away.
I am coming over.
Cold. Good.
Eating it makes my shell harder.
One piece is not enough.
Throw another.
I have tasted your scent before.
Do not fool me. I can smell iron.
You rolled over my tail.
My shell chilled your boot.
I rolled half a turn.
We cracked the ice between us.
Your boot kicked my segment.

lines.zh: 雪地里我身上结了一层霜。
lines.en: A layer of frost has set on me in the snow.
The cold was knocked off me.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地的霜，结在我壳上。
lines.en: Frost from the ice spikes sets on my shell.
I slide past your foot.
Make way.
The four of us crowd into an ice crack.
It is whiter than I.
Our cold mingles.
There is a brood under the ice.
We do not fight over food.
It crawls out first.
I follow at the back.
All of the brood carry blue light.
The weather grows colder.
It shares half its iron with me.
I want this piece of ice.
I crush it in my jaws.
Not iron.
It is melting.
I crawl with it in my jaws.
Too heavy.
I dug this out of the ice.
What falls on the ice, I take.
I tossed it.
Feed me iron and I harden.
You are in front of me.
I smell warmth.

lines.zh: 冰刺之地的源石虫，冻得发亮。
lines.en: An Originium worm from the ice spikes, glinting cold.
This breath of cold goes to you first.
My cold is full.
Frost is forming on the crystals along my back.
The ice under you will crack.
I give you three breaths.
Something warm cannot run far.
The cold arrives first.
The ice shell cracks — too late to dodge.
This is that breath.
I go along the ice.
My ice shell is drawn tight.
I am closer.
The blue light is on you.
On ice I keep my footing better.
The cold is gathering.
You're shivering — the ice chips are falling off.
The cold has reached my throat.
All this ice is mine.
There is only one path across the ice.
Further and it is water.
I lie low and wait for a misstep.
I ram your shin.
The cold bursts out.
The ice cracks in a ring.
You went rigid.
My jaws clamped.
That came with frost.
My jaws have shut.
Come again.
There is blood on the ice.
It looks good.
I come up from under the ice sheet.
The blue light comes on first.
The four of us came together.
It is cold here.
I shake off the frost.
Wind drives snow into my shell seams.
First I find the thickest ice.
This snowfield is large.

lines.zh: 霜从我的节缝里冒出来。
lines.en: Frost seeps from between my segments.
The ice-blast oriworms are all here.
Fire touches me and my shell runs.
I hit the ice and every segment rings.

lines.zh: 冷水灌进壳缝，我沉下去。
lines.en: Cold water fills my seams and I sink.
The heat throws me up.
Something went through my shell.

lines.zh: 这股热流钻进来，我难受。
lines.en: Heat seeps in. It hurts.
Hungry this long, my cold weakens.
Lightning strikes and the ice bursts.
Inside the ice shell, only void wind.
